key_insight: Reliable work agents combine foundation models with runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps engineers reason about agent capabilities, runtime design, optimization, and evaluation around completed work rather than generated responses.
method: Characterize working conditions by work persistence and work openness.
Classify digital work into five forms and identify five core capability families.
Examine model, harness, and joint optimization alongside outcome-focused evaluation.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a conceptual framework and analysis of existing evaluation methods, but reports no datasets, benchmark scores, or quantitative validation.
watch_item: The framework's practical benefits remain to be validated, especially for sustained delegation in open environments.
paper_title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
